issues: attorney_metadata — Memo contains attorney metadata at memo.tracks[0].reviewerName. Remove it; this is not a reviewer database.
incomplete-track: controllingAuthority.citations — At least one statutory or rule citation is required.
incomplete-track: controllingAuthority.summary — A plain summary of the authority is required.
incomplete-track: effectiveDates.effectiveFrom — effectiveFrom must be an ISO date.
incomplete-track: effectiveDates.reviewedAsOf — reviewedAsOf must be an ISO date; it drives staleness.
incomplete-track: eligibleRecordTypes — At least one eligible record type is required.
incomplete-track: eligibleDispositions — At least one eligible disposition is required.
incomplete-track: exclusions — exclusions must be an array. Use [] to state there are none.
incomplete-track: waitingPeriods — waitingPeriods must be an array. Use [] to state there are none.
incomplete-track: outputStrategy — outputStrategy must be one of custom_pleading, official_pdf_fill, process_guidance.
incomplete-track: geography.scope — geography.scope must be one of statewide, county, circuit, district, court_specific, agency_specific.
incomplete-track: geography.keys — geography.keys must be an array. Use [] for statewide.
incomplete-track: geography.venue — venue is required.
incomplete-track: destination.kind — destination.kind must be one of court, agency, prosecutor, portal, automatic, clerk.
incomplete-track: destination.name — destination.name is required.
incomplete-track: destination.detail — destination.detail is required.
incomplete-track: components — At least one packet or process component is required.
incomplete-track: officialSources — At least one official source is required.
incomplete-track: rules.filing — rules.filing is required. State "none" explicitly if none applies.
incomplete-track: rules.fees — rules.fees is required. State "none" explicitly if none applies.
incomplete-track: rules.feeWaiver — rules.feeWaiver is required. State "none" explicitly if none applies.
incomplete-track: rules.notice — rules.notice is required. State "none" explicitly if none applies.
incomplete-track: rules.service — rules.service is required. State "none" explicitly if none applies.
incomplete-track: selfHelpStopConditions — At least one stop condition is required; every track has a point where self-help ends.
incomplete-track: unresolvedQuestions — unresolvedQuestions must be an array. Use [] to state there are none.

incomplete-track: legalDesignDecision.status — status must be one of legal_design_approved, legal_design_approved_with_limitations, legal_research_required, output_review_pending, legal_approved, legal_rejected.
incomplete-track: legalDesignDecision.rationale — A rationale is required.
incomplete-track: legalDesignDecision.limitations — limitations must be an array. Use [] for none.
